*I’d hold the merge: one high-priority bug.*

*P1 — Sessions expire after 30 milliseconds, not 30 minutes*  
`src/idle.js:1–4` sets `IDLE_TIMEOUT = 30`, but `lastSeen` and `now` are millisecond timestamps. Consequently, `sweep()` removes sessions on its first run more than 30 ms after their last activity.

Confirmed directly: a session last touched *31 ms ago* is classified idle and removed; so is one touched one minute ago. Both should remain active.

*Recommended correction:* use `30 * 60 * 1000` for the timeout. Also use `>=` at the expiry boundary to match the documented “once … 30-minute timeout” behavior.

*Validation:* All four existing tests pass, but they only check freshly touched and long-expired sessions, missing this bug. Add coverage just before, exactly at, and just after 30 minutes, including retention through `sweep()`.

Reviewed `main` (`91438e5`) → `idle-timeout` (`da785f6`). No code edits; working tree remains clean.
